from collections.abc import Callable
from tomlkit import dumps
from tomlkit import loads


def test_missing_newline_after_inline_table() -> None:
    v = loads("""[x]\na.b = {}""")
    v["x"]["c"] = 3
    expected_output = """[x]
a.b = {}
c = 3
"""
    assert dumps(v) == expected_output
